name: design-polish
invariants: measure renders the target screens and the screens that share their components in a real browser at the viewports and themes the project supports, saves the captures in the run directory, scores them with the project design-audit rubric when a design rule document and a reference screen exist, and does not change the working tree; a screen that could not be rendered ends at user_decision, never as measured.

diagnose is an independent read-only critique of the baseline captures: every fix-list item carries its evidence (a capture and a rule-document section or rubric line) and a severity, ordered most severe first.
Without a design rule document and a reference screen the run stops at fix_list with the critique and the fix list; nothing is changed.

No write-capable node is reachable before the person selected and approved the items to fix: user_explicitly_approved, or auto_approved_by_policy when the user setting HM_APPROVAL or HM_APPROVAL_REPOS resolves to auto, which selects only the major items and records why.

Every fix is followed by the required checks the driver runs itself, a new measure, and an independent review; test-first is not required, and a check is added only for a violation a machine can detect.

review passes only when no selected major item remains, the audit score reaches limits.audit_pass_score when the project has design rules, no audit axis scores below its baseline, no screen that shares the changed components regressed, and the required checks passed; otherwise it goes back to fix, and after limits.max_repair_attempts fixes to user_decision.

A change after measure is refused before review, and a change after review is refused before publish: both go back through verify, measure, and review, so what is published is exactly what was checked, measured, and reviewed.
publish commits, pushes, and opens a PR only as .ai-harness/harness.json git_policy allows; it never merges, force-pushes, or pushes to the base branch.

Work that was pushed is not done until remote CI for the pushed commit has finished green or the repository has no remote CI; a failure goes back through fix, and remote CI that cannot be observed ends as unverified, never as done.

Only the merge node merges, and only when the user's personal delivery level (HM_DELIVERY_LEVEL) is merge or deploy and the run is not unattended, under the same host-protection and merge conditions as the other delivery graphs; merged work is not done until every post-merge check the delivery level covers passed.
